question: The first and last terms of an A.P. are 18 and 48. If the sum of its terms is 396, then the number of terms will be?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Number of terms (n) = (2 × Sum) ÷ (First term + Last term)

n = (2 × 396) ÷ (18 + 48)

n = 792 ÷ 66

n = 12

**∴ The correct answer is 12.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

**First term (a)** = 18

**Last term (l)** = 48

**Sum of terms (Sₙ)** = 396

**Formula Used:**

Sₙ = (n/2) × (a + l)

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/374af85993bcefa3456f50dde5db69aded2751ede08f18890fee7e0a937f1d4b.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ 396 = (n/2) × (18 + 48)

⇒ 396 = (n/2) × 66

⇒ 396 = n × 33

⇒ n = 396 ÷ 33

⇒ n = 12

**∴ The correct answer is 12.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Common Difference Formula

The nth term is given by aₙ = a + (n − 1)d, where d is the common difference.

Sum of First n Terms

Sₙ = (n/2) × [2a + (n − 1)d]. This formula is used when the last term is unknown.

Properties of A.P.

In an A.P., the sum of terms equidistant from the beginning and the end is always constant and equal to (a + l).</p
